sentences.text:
Santosh Kamble
Kamble Date: 2025.07.11 Ms.Anuja S. Gotad, App, for Respondent No.1-State.

17:40:02 +0530
 Ms.Gauri S. Velankar, for Respondent No.2.
 Mr.Mangesh Nawde, Psi, Central Police Station, Ulhasnagar.

----
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.

Date : 09th July 2025
 P.C:-
 .

The Special Court has rejected the Anti
 Application of the Appellant.

2.  The Appellant is apprehending arrest, in connection with investigation of Crime No.246 of 2023 registered with Vithalwadi Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 377,
323, 504 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC' for short) and Sections 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(s) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of N.S. Kamble page 1 of 3 64-APEAL-1198-2023.doc Atrocities) Act, 1989 ('SCST Act' for short).
Gangadhar S/O. Prabhunath Dubey vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr. on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152668999/
1 3.
It is prosecution's case that, Accused No.1 sexually assaulted the first informant on various occasions under the promise of marriage.
It is alleged that, he refused to marry with the first informant.
It is alleged that, Appellant is father of the Accused No.1 and the abused the first informant on her caste.
4. It is contention of the learned counsel for the Appellant that, the Appellant is on interim relief for two years.
He has co-operated with the investigation.
The main allegations are against Accused No.1.
The Appellant is a senior citizen.
Custodial interrogation of the Appellant is not required and requested to allow the Appeal.

5. It is contention of the learned APP and learned counsel for Respondent No.2 that, the Appellant is the father of the Accused No.1, when first informant met the Appellant, he abused her on caste, in filthy language.
Incident happened in the public view.
Considering the allegations against the Appellant, his custodial interrogation is required and requested to dismiss the Appeal.
N.S. Kamble page 2 of 3 64-APEAL-1198-2023.doc 6.
I have heard all learned counsel.
Perused FIR and documents produced on record.
7. The main allegations are against the Accused no.1.

This Court (Coram : Bharati H. Dangre, J.)
vide order dated 1 st November 2023 has granted anticipatory bail to the Appellant.
Since then, he is on interim bail and has co-operated in the investigation.
As main allegations are against the Accused No.1, he was arrested and released on regular bail.
8. Considering these facts, custodial interrogation of the Appellant is not required.

9. In such circumstances, the Criminal Appeal is allowed and disposed of in terms of the order dated 1 st November 2023, it is made absolute subject to condition that the Appellant shall report to the Investigating Officer as and when required, and shall co-operate with the Investigating Agency and the Appellant shall not contact with the first informant and prosecution witnesses.
10. All pending Applications are disposed of.

(SHIVKUMAR DIGE, J.)
 N.S. Kamble page 3 of 3 Gangadhar S/O. Prabhunath Dubey vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr.
